newsitem.title: TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO: Police and thieves have grave problems in Trinidad.
newsitem.headline: Police and thieves have grave problems in Trinidad.

text.p: Vandals and grave robbers are preventing the dead from resting in peace in Trinidad and Tobago.

Police in the Caribbean nation's capital Port of Spain are cracking down on vagrants and "undesirables" who have been living in the city's cemeteries and stealing from graves, the Trinidad Guardian newspaper reported on Wednesday.
"We are receiving too many reports of people, especially drug addicts, robbing from the dead," city official Rishi Lakhan was quoted as saying.
"They are taking lead from the coffins and caskets and the copper and brass fittings from vault doors."
People no longer feel safe going to pay their respects to dead relatives, he added.
"It is deploring and disheartening to see humans so desperate that they are sleeping among the dead and stealing from the dead," Lakhan said.
